_doc: Server->client opcodes, keyed by the two bytes as they appear on the wire (e.g. "4136" = bytes 41 36). status: community = taken from reference repos, unverified by our captures; hypothesis = claimed by a single source; observed = seen in our captures, layout partly checked; verified = confirmed in our own captures (see docs/FINDINGS.md). Only names are used so far; nothing is decoded from this list yet.

0036.name: Heartbeat
0036.note: u64 server unix ms, ~19-20/s; resync anchor 0E 00 36

2136.name: MapLoad
2136.note: u32 load count, u32 map id; TheLoop encoder: + instance, 0, x y z heading f32

3436.name: ObjSpawn
3436.note: id varint, kind u16, template u32, x y z f32, f32, heading f32, 3 bytes, created u64 ms; Hidden Cube Verteron = template 1200039

3536.name: ObjRemove
3536.note: id varint, reason u8 (04 destroyed/opened, 01 left view)

3a36.name: ObjOpenDone
3a36.note: object varint, actor varint, count u32, item u32 (cube: 1 x 0x259AC523, presumably the key)

4136.name: Spawn
4136.note: NPC/summon/effect; x y z heading f32 after npc u32 + m1 m2

1f56.name: LootGone?
1f56.note: 01, object u32, u32, drop id u32, ... (after cube loot)

1a37.name: EntityPos?
1a37.note: id varint, 2 bytes, x y z f32

0238.name: Cast
0238.note: kind 2: heading + caster x y z

0338.name: HitNotice
0338.note: uid u32, x y z f32 after skill

2a38.name: PosRecordA
2a38.source: NOIA2/Kuroukihime (buff), Cube Watch (self position); own captures 2026-10-13
2a38.note: tail = entity varint again, 01 00, x y z: position of that entity (own id = most frequent)

1e56.name: Loot
1e56.note: 01, object u32, object x y z, drop x y z, u32, drop id u32, item u32, count u32, ...

0191.name: FieldBossList
0191.note: x y z f32 per alive slot
